# [fieldwork] Validation walk + 6 measurement walks (team task)

**Team task (manual).** Validate the app, then collect the data.

## Tasks
- [ ] Dry-run walk with both phones, fill validation sheet
- [ ] 3 off-peak walks (8:00–9:00), 3 peak walks (12:30–13:30), both phones every walk, roles swapped per protocol
- [ ] Copy raw CSVs unmodified to `data/raw/` and commit; fill walk logs in `data/field-notes/`

## Done when
- 12 CSVs (6 walks × 2 phones) + walk logs committed.
